about.title: About Life-Coaching AI
about.paragraph1: Life-Coaching AI gives you a private space to think things through, explore your feelings, and work toward meaningful goals. If you choose to sign in, your goals help the AI understand your direction — so the guidance stays relevant without needing to repeat yourself.
about.whyMattersParagraph: Finding your direction in life is not easy. Real life-coaching is built on asking the right questions — the ones that help you think deeper, gain clarity, and make choices that truly belong to you. Skilled life-coaches study for years to master this approach because asking the wrong questions can unintentionally push a person toward the wrong path.
about.whyAiCanHelpParagraph: Life-Coaching AI uses structured coaching techniques consistently and without personal biases. It doesn’t judge, get distracted, or project its own emotions onto you. Because it has no personal interests, it cannot influence you for its own benefit. Instead, it focuses entirely on helping you think clearly, reflect honestly, and make decisions aligned with your own values and goals.
about.whyAppExistsParagraph: Professional life coaching can be expensive and inaccessible. This app offers guidance, structure, and emotional clarity to anyone — privately, affordably, and at your own pace.
about.howItWorksBullet1: Anonymous Chat — start talking instantly, no login needed.
about.howItWorksBullet2: Personalized Coaching — after signing in, your goals become part of the conversation.
about.howItWorksBullet3: Goal Tracking — add, edit, and organize goals like simple notes.
about.howItWorksBullet4: Account Control — delete your account and all data anytime.
about.howItWorksBullet5: Mobile + Web — use whichever is more comfortable for you.
about.privacyFirstParagraph: Your conversations and goals are private. The app does not use ads or tracking. You can delete your account and all stored data at any moment from the menu.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.introduction_body: Welcome to the {appName} mobile application. This Privacy Policy outlines our practices regarding the collection, use, and disclosure of information that we receive through our app. Our primary goal is to provide you with an interactive AI experience while respecting your privacy.
privacy.info_collect_body: We collect the following personal data when you use the app:
privacy.user_id_collect_prefix: - User ID: A unique identifier generated by
privacy.user_id_collect_suffix: to associate your account with your data.
privacy.goals_collect: - Goals: Titles and content of your personal goals are stored in our backend database.
privacy.storage_security_body1_prefix: Your goals and related data are securely stored in
privacy.storage_security_body1_suffix: , a widely used, industry-standard NoSQL database. MongoDB is known for its robust security features, and we use it to ensure your data is stored safely.
privacy.storage_security_body2_prefix: Additionally, you can delete your data anytime through the app or by visiting our
privacy.storage_security_body2_suffix: page for detailed steps on how to delete your account and all associated data.
privacy.sharing_info_body: We do not share or sell your personal data to any third parties except in the following circumstances:
privacy.sharing_info_bullet1: - When required by law or to comply with legal processes.
privacy.sharing_info_bullet2: - When necessary to protect the rights, safety, and property of our company or other users.
privacy.rights_choices_body: You have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.rights_choices_bullet1: - Access: You can request access to the personal data we store about you.
privacy.rights_choices_bullet2: - Deletion: You can request that we delete your personal data.
privacy.rights_choices_bullet3: - Modification: You can request corrections or updates to your personal data if it is inaccurate.
privacy.changes_policy_body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. When we do, we will notify you through the app or by other means so you can review the updated policy before continuing to use the app.
